interface.title: CellPilot AI (read-only Streamlit dashboard)
interface.field: Single-cell transcriptomics / immunology (PBMC scRNA-seq cell-type annotation)
interface.stage_of_work: Reviewing results after analysis, and checking reproducibility and provenance
interface.what_it_is_for: A read-only dashboard for reviewing the saved results of a CellPilot run on the 10x PBMC 3k dataset: QC, Leiden clusters and marker genes, CellTypist annotation, cautious per-cluster interpretation, a 5-class FACS benchmark and the hash-recorded provenance manifest.

data.note: The run directory results/pbmc3k/verified_run is pre-filled from CELLPILOT_RUN_DIR. It was built from the repository's committed evidence/ and docs/figures/ files. Some tables were never committed, so the dashboard says 'QC table is unavailable' and 'Marker table is unavailable'. The Provenance tab lists 34 verification failures: 32 files are 'missing' (raw downloads, FACS archives, the CellTypist .pkl model, the processed .h5ad, per-cell tables and benchmark CSVs). The other two are a size mismatch and a sha256 mismatch on annotation/celltypist_metadata.json. This comes from how the demo was installed; the dashboard itself is not broken.

features.name: Run-folder picker with artifact-presence checks
features.general: Type the path of one saved analysis run. Every view reloads from that folder and says plainly which expected files are missing, without filling the gaps.
features.specific: Sidebar 'Run directory' text box, pre-filled from CELLPILOT_RUN_DIR. Shows 'Run directory does not exist', 'No analysis_summary.json is present; this run is incomplete' or 'Artifact not available: umap_clusters.png'
steps: type a run directory path and press Enter
pick a page from the Page radio list
read the error or info box for anything missing
switch back to a complete run
serves_tasks: Load the results folder of one analysis run
See what happens when a run folder is wrong or incomplete

features.name: Collapsible JSON viewer with copy-out
features.general: Browse any nested record: fold long branches away and copy a value or sub-record to the clipboard
features.specific: Generic st.json widget with fold carets and hover copy icons, used e.g. for Stage status, CellTypist metadata and the verification failure list
steps: click a caret to collapse or expand a branch
scroll to the field of interest
hover a value or object and press its copy icon
paste the copied JSON elsewhere
serves_tasks: Check that every pipeline stage finished
Check which reference model was used and that the input fitted it
Check recorded files against their stored hashes and read the declared limitations

features.name: Per-group label consensus table
features.general: For each group of cells, show the dominant predicted label, group size, mean confidence and the fraction of members that agree. Sort, search and trim columns to find weak groups.
features.specific: Cluster consensus dataframe (cluster, predicted_label, n_cells, mean_confidence, fraction) with sort, Search, Show/hide columns, Fullscreen and cell copy
steps: click a column header to sort (e.g. by fraction)
press Search and type part of a label
open Show/hide columns and untick columns
press Fullscreen
select a cell and press Ctrl+C to copy its full-precision value
serves_tasks: See which label dominates each group and how strongly

features.name: Classifier benchmark panel: headline metrics, confusion matrix, per-class table
features.general: Score a classifier against independent reference labels. Headline metrics come first, then a confusion matrix that has a column for unmapped predictions, then a per-class precision/recall/F1 table you can sort and summarise.
features.specific: Benchmark page: Cells benchmarked, Mapped coverage, Strict accuracy and Strict macro-F1 tiles, the metrics JSON, a 'CellTypist strict five-class FACS benchmark' heatmap with an __unmapped__ column, and a per-class table
steps: read the headline metric tiles
look along the confusion-matrix rows for off-diagonal counts
sort the per-class table by recall
open a column menu > Statistics for mean, median and min
Format > Percent to show recall as percentages
serves_tasks: See which classes get confused with each other

features.name: Hash-verified provenance manifest
features.general: Recompute the hashes and sizes of recorded inputs and outputs, list each file as missing or mismatched, warn when the run can't be trusted as intact, and show the full manifest and declared limitations
features.specific: Provenance & limitations: red 'Manifest verification failed; do not trust this run as intact.' banner, a list of {path, kind: missing/size_mismatch/sha256_mismatch, expected, actual}, the Artifact manifest (command, random_seed, config_sha256, outputs with sha256/size) and Declared limitations
steps: open the Provenance & limitations page
read the verification banner
go through or copy the failure list
collapse it to reach the Artifact manifest
read the Declared limitations
serves_tasks: Check recorded files against their stored hashes and read the declared limitations

features.name: Captioned figure gallery with fullscreen
features.general: Show saved static analysis figures with captions, and open any of them fullscreen to look closely
features.specific: Leiden UMAP, top-marker dot plot and QC violin images with 'Fullscreen: …' buttons
steps: pick a page that has figures
hover a figure and press its Fullscreen button
read the enlarged figure
press Escape or the shrink button to go back
serves_tasks: Look at per-cell quality distributions and how many cells were kept after filtering
Look at the cell groupings and the genes that set each group apart

features.name: Evidence-bounded per-cluster interpretation record
features.general: For each cell group, propose a label with a stated confidence level, name the evidence behind it (marker genes or reference-label agreement) and its uncertainties, leave a group 'unresolved' when the evidence is weak, and warn that these are hypotheses, not experimental validation
features.specific: Evidence-grounded interpretation page: warning 'evidence-bounded hypotheses, not experimental validation' above interpretations[] records (proposed_label, confidence, evidence IDs, uncertainties), e.g. cluster 0 'unresolved' (low; LDHB/RPS12/RPS25), clusters 1–3 moderate from CellTypist, cluster 5 'Dendritic cell' (low; FCER1A/CST3/HLA-DRA, marker-panel heuristic)
steps: open the Evidence-grounded interpretation page
read the hypotheses warning at the top
go through each cluster's proposed label and confidence
read the evidence genes and uncertainties, noting any 'unresolved' cluster
copy a cluster's record with its copy icon
serves_tasks: Read the cautious per-group interpretation, including the group left unresolved
